name: cravekart-monorepo
description: CraveKart - Premium Online Food Ordering Platform

scripts.dev: npm run dev --prefix server & npm run dev --prefix client
scripts.vercel-build: cd server && npm install && npx prisma generate --schema=prisma/schema.prisma && npm run build && cd ../client && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix server && npm run test --prefix client
scripts.setup: cd server && npm install && npx prisma generate && cd ../client && npm install

author: CraveKart Team
